idea-plugin.name: groovyfmt
idea-plugin.description:
Formats and lints Groovy, Gradle build scripts and Jenkinsfiles with groovyfmt, a fast formatter and linter written in Rust. The plugin starts groovyfmt --lsp, the language server built into the groovyfmt binary, through LSP4IJ, so the IDE gives the same results as the command line.

  • parse errors and lint violations as you type, with a quick fix for each fixable violation and a fix-all action
  • Code | Reformat with groovyfmt formats the file with groovyfmt
  • optionally, Reformat Code (and so the Reformat code action on save) uses groovyfmt in place of the IDE's Groovy formatter

It covers *.groovy, *.gvy, *.gy, *.gsh, *.gradle, *.jenkinsfile, Jenkinsfile and Jenkinsfile.*, and works alongside the bundled Groovy and Gradle support and any Jenkins plugin.

It runs the groovyfmt you installed (a path setting, the project's npm package, or PATH), or offers to download the release that matches its own version, checked against SHA-256 checksums packaged into the plugin when it was built. In an untrusted project nothing from the project decides which binary runs. No telemetry.
